F01.evidence: runtime.py _watch_lease acquires binding.normal_lock then control_lock before closing an expired session; a send holding normal_lock blocks containment indefinitely.

F02.evidence: kernel.execute checks the lease only before admit; no revalidation after admit/mark_possible_effect awaits nor at the native dispatch point (to_thread).

F03.evidence: runtime._pump only faults the binding on exceptions; normal iterator exhaustion (EOF with a live process) leaves the session accepting new work.

F04.evidence: SQLiteJournal executes connect/execute/commit/checkpoint directly inside async methods under an asyncio lock; a held database lock blocks the event loop and its timers.

F05.evidence: _external_operation_id admits IDs up to 256 chars while reconcile validates 1-160; IDs of 161-256 are admitted but not reconcilable (raw ValueError).

F06.evidence: self._sessions entries are never removed after close; bindings retain NativeSession/adapter references indefinitely.

F07.evidence: profiles.py maps LaunchIntent.model into argv only for pi_rpc; codex argv is (exe,'app-server') with no model mechanism and claude argv has no model flag.

G01.evidence: no public runtime factory; consumers must import CopiedAdapterFactory from the private native.runtime_bridge module; RuntimeCore Protocol lacks persisted_lease.

G02.evidence: qualification keys are path-bound composites for Pi (allowlist entry embeds absolute Node/CLI paths); no portable build_identity exists.

G03.evidence: discovery only supports explicit paths/trusted roots; no layout resolvers (Pi Node+CLI autodiscovery, known Windows shims).

G04.evidence: attach mode is rejected by the managed factory (profiles.prepare_launch raises CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED for mode != managed); no public attach lifecycle.

G05.evidence: no containment preflight: managed opens do not verify backend requirements (e.g. /proc interfaces, job objects) before spawning provider work; no PROCESS_CONTAINMENT_UNAVAILABLE.

G06.evidence: 27 TK PASS with scope notes exist, but E0-E3 release levels are not formalized and several claims still exceed strictly local evidence; attach/Linux/host-integration gates remain open.
